S0959.reason: Subtracting the first equation from the second gives 3x + 3y = 3, so x + y = 1; solving the system yields x = -3, y = 4, so x - y = -7? Wait, check: 888x + 889y = 890, 891x + 892y = 893. Subtract: 3x + 3y = 3 => x + y = 1. Then from first: 888x + 889(1 - x) = 890 => 888x + 889 - 889x = 890 => -x + 889 = 890 => x = -1, y = 2, so x - y = -3.
